answer: Reputation-gated task admission. Each agent identity must accumulate a public task history before bidding; new identities start outside a canyon of low-trust queues and can only take low-value work. A river of scored completions unlocks higher-value contracts. Cloning splits history, so each copy restarts at zero and pays repeated onboarding compute and delay, while the original's crystal of verified record stays with one identity. Marginal clone EV is negative.
